# Terraform AWS Infisical Gateway

Terraform module for deploying an [Infisical Gateway](https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/gateways/overview) on AWS EC2.

## Usage

```hcl
module "infisical_gateway" {
  source = "path/to/terraform-aws-infisical-gateway"

  gateway_name     = "production-gateway"
  infisical_domain = "https://app.infisical.com"
  vpc_id           = "vpc-12345678"
  subnet_id        = "subnet-12345678"

  auth = {
    method = "token"
    token  = [REDACTED]  # From Infisical UI
  }

  tags = {
    Environment = "production"
  }
}
```

## Obtaining the Enrollment Token

1. Navigate to **Organization Settings > Networking > Gateways** in the Infisical UI
2. Click **Create Gateway**
3. Enter a name and select a relay (or use "Auto Select Relay")
4. Copy the enrollment token from the generated CLI command

> **Note:** The enrollment token expires after 1 hour.

## Network Requirements

The gateway only requires **outbound** connections:

| Protocol | Destination | Port | Purpose |
|----------|-------------|------|---------|
| TCP | Relay Server | 2222 | SSH reverse tunnel |
| TCP | Infisical API | 443 | API communication |

## Inputs

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
|------|-------------|------|---------|:--------:|
| gateway_name | Name for the gateway instance | `string` | n/a | yes |
| infisical_domain | Domain of the Infisical instance | `string` | n/a | yes |
| vpc_id | VPC ID for deployment | `string` | n/a | yes |
| subnet_id | Subnet ID for deployment | `string` | n/a | yes |
| auth | Authentication configuration (see below) | `object` | n/a | yes |
| target_relay_name | Specific relay to connect to | `string` | `""` | no |
| instance_type | EC2 instance type | `string` | `"t3.small"` | no |
| volume_size | Root volume size in GB | `number` | `20` | no |
| tags | Tags to apply to resources | `map(string)` | `{}` | no |

### Auth Object

```hcl
auth = {
  method = "token"           # Enrollment method: "token" (more methods coming)
  token  = "your-token"      # Required when method = "token"
}
```

## Outputs

| Name | Description |
|------|-------------|
| instance_id | EC2 instance ID |
| private_ip | Private IP address |
| public_ip | Public IP address |
| security_group_id | Security group ID |
| iam_role_arn | IAM role ARN |

## Verifying Deployment

```bash
# Check service status
sudo systemctl status infisical-gateway

# View logs
sudo journalctl -u infisical-gateway -f

# Run health check
/usr/local/bin/check-gateway-health.sh
```
